releaseNotes: Expanded onboarding into typed ONB-00 through ONB-22 catalog nodes so the durable engine can schedule, fan out, join, checkpoint, retry, resume, and verify the complete consumer onboarding system rather than executing one coarse prose node.

Rebuilt product/ONBOARDING.md as the canonical evidence, first-value, state, identity, analytics, design, monetization, lifecycle, implementation, hard-cutover, and zero-legacy contract, with a faithful searchable generated HTML view.

Added check:onboarding-graph to both package layouts and the standard audit, with deterministic fixtures for review timing, deferrals, placeholder completion, typed screen and control contracts, and legacy removal. Updated app-agent roles to continue the graph through Compound Engineering implementation and final proof.
